items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I had taken Bobby Hackett's place with The Joe Sullivan Trio -- with Hayes Alvis on the base -- and Joe Sullivan and me.

ctx.x: And, of course, at different times in that same period of time, I even worked the Onyx Club and I worked also - Brun's and I - once just took off and went up to Jimmy Ryan's and played there for a week or two and I played at a place called The Keyboard Lounge across the street; these are all little jobbing things and I was with the--- at the Onyx I was with - at that time - doing this little thing, I had taken Bobby Hackett's place with The Joe Sullivan Trio -- with Hayes Alvis on the base -- and Joe Sullivan and…
And, poor Bobby was having trouble then--- as I recall---
